Data.subject: Geographic Distribution
Data.groupTitle: Singapore Residents By Planning Region, Age Group And Sex, End June
Data.title: Singapore Residents By Planning Region, Age Group And Sex, End June, Annual
Data.footnote: Planning Regions refer to areas demarcated in the Urban Redevelopment Authority's Master Plan 2014 for Year 2019, Master Plan 2019 for Year 2020-2025 and Master Plan 2025 for Year 2026. Data from 2003 onwards exclude residents who have been away from Singapore for a continuous period of 12 months or longer as at the reference period. Data has been rounded to the nearest 10 and may not add up due to rounding. Please exercise caution when comparing data based on planning areas demarcated according to the different Urban Redevelopment Authority's Master Plans.
